keyEvents.text: Ricardo Chávez (Monterrey) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Querétaro 0, Monterrey 0.
Substitution, Monterrey. Aldo de Nigris replaces César Garza.
Substitution, Monterrey. Luca Orellano replaces Ricardo Chávez.
Goal! Querétaro 0, Monterrey 1. Diego Rossi (Monterrey) right footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal.
Daniel Parra (Querétaro) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Guillermo Allison (Querétaro) is shown the red card.
Roberto de la Rosa (Monterrey) is shown the yellow card.
keyEvents.shortText: Roberto de la Rosa Yellow Card

keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Roberto de la Rosa (Monterrey).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Querétaro. José Hernández replaces Iker Benito.
Substitution, Querétaro. Paulo Victor replaces Daniel Parra.
Delay in match (Monterrey).
Delay in match (Querétaro). VAR checking.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Monterrey. Fidel Ambríz replaces Roberto de la Rosa.
Substitution, Querétaro. Denilson Muñoz replaces Carlos Villanueva.
Denilson Muñoz (Querétaro) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Lucas Abascia (Querétaro) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Monterrey. Jorge Rodríguez replaces Diego Rossi.
Substitution, Querétaro. Eduardo Pérez replaces Alí Ávila.
Substitution, Querétaro. Waldo Madrid replaces Carlo García.
Eduardo Pérez (Querétaro) is shown the red card.
Diego Reyes (Querétaro) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Querétaro 0, Monterrey 1.
